metadata.title: Text media (comics and manga) - editorial seed
metadata.note: Same row shapes as media_atlas_seed.json. Titles and years are facts; no synopsis is copied from any source. Every row is needs_review and every adaptation certainty is unknown until a person reviews it. A null release_year means no source stated it yet: the local AniList / Comic Vine cache may fill it in the app, marked as imported.
